source_scope: evidence/index.json and referenced current-run public page captures
notes: Read-only review of this run only. No browsing, recollection, cart mutation, form submission, account creation, or order attempt.
Collection is partial: 25 usable pages, 16 complete and 9 partial; persona journeys are partial. Findings are limited to directly captured evidence.

keep_protect.observation: The collected Glucare product detail exposes a unit price of 9,000 VND, a quantity control initially set to 1, an add-to-cart control, and a Buy Now control. The product form is present in the captured public page; its submission was not performed.
The high-intent and mobile journeys each reach the Glucare landing page through a verified visible homepage link. Both stop before any cart or checkout mutation.
keep_protect.scope: page instances in two recorded journeys

keep_protect.observation: A public order-policy route is linked and reached from the research journey.

rubric.item: Product price, offers, purchase options, quantity, and product-page CTA
rubric.observation: The captured product detail shows 9.000,00 ₫ (VND), a quantity input with value 1 and maxAllowed 1, plus Add to Cart and Buy Now submit controls. The evidence does not establish a discounted offer or its business validity.

rubric.item: Visible route from product to cart
rubric.scope: page instances and recorded journeys; no site-pattern claim
rubric.observation: The product detail capture contains cart-add and Buy Now submit controls. Recorded high-intent and mobile journeys reached /sua-hat-glucare-plus and report no visible safe matching cart route; the journeys intentionally stopped before interacting with purchase controls. No cart was opened or populated.

rubric.item: Checkout form simplicity and guest checkout (REQ-016 / REQ-016-01)
rubric.scope: journey-level reachability limitation; no checkout page instance captured
rubric.observation: The high-intent journey could not find a visible safe cart or checkout route from its observed UI, and the mobile journey could not find a visible cart route. The journeys were partial and stopped before mutation, so checkout fields and whether account creation is required remain unobserved. Checklist requirement text is not proof of failure.

rubric.item: Visible payment options, order confirmation, and KiotViet handoff (REQ-017 / REQ-017-01)
rubric.scope: checkout page instance not captured; order-policy page is a separate captured instance
rubric.observation: No checkout page or success state was reached. The order-policy route was reached, but available captured evidence does not establish COD, bank transfer, an order confirmation, or KiotViet integration. Payment execution, order completion, and downstream handoff are unknown.

rubric.scope: no captured shipping-policy or checkout page instance in the permitted inspected evidence
rubric.observation: The inventory/discovery shows a shipping-policy route, but the recorded journeys and inspected evidence do not establish its terms, shipping charges, delivery timing, or checkout shipping choices.

rubric.item: Cart totals, stock validation, payment processing, fulfillment, and completed checkout
rubric.scope: no cart or checkout page instance captured; transaction was not attempted
rubric.observation: No cart mutation or transaction occurred. Captures cannot establish cart calculations, stock synchronization, payment processing, fulfillment, or successful checkout.

coverage.safe_stopping_point: Glucare landing page via recorded visible navigation; separate captured Glucare catalog detail exposes cart/buy controls but no control was activated.
safety_blockers: Run safety settings disable cart mutation, orders, payments, and account creation.

High-intent/mobile journeys did not observe a safe visible cart/checkout path from their reached landing page.
unknowns: No checkout form inspection or guest order validation.
